payload.reason: The evidence provides multiple methods for empirically evaluating the quality of the data, including BLEU scores, model output variance, and manual inspections.

claims.text: The quality of the data is evaluated using BLEU scores and model output variance to assess translation quality and stability across different speakers.
Validated transcripts are used for CoVoST, ensuring that only high-quality data is included in the dataset.
Manual inspections and perplexity measurements are conducted to ensure translation quality, with low-quality translations sent back for revision.
